title: The Nature of Doctrines
paragraphs: I want to speak to you this morning on the topic, AND PLEASE GET A BRAND NEWSHEET OF PAPER or a new notebook. We're going to begin our series on doctrines. And the session for our opening session is going to be entitled the nature ofdoctrines. The nature of doctrine. A subtitle couldbe very helpful, and that is going to be understandingthe value of doctrine. I want to say that the present state of our world todaygive us great cause for much fear, confusion, disillusionment, and despair.

As one looks at the seemingly uninsurmountable problemsand challenges and dilemmas that are facing us every day. Earth to me is like a giant spaceship moving at warp speed without a flightplan on a collision course with disaster. That's how I'm beginning to understand this planet. Despite all thetechnological and scientific discoveries and the developments and advancement inhuman life, we can describe man as simply asophisticated barbarismculture. As advanced as we are, we are asuncivilized as ever.

We have become cybernetic cavemen. We are simply cavemen with computers. WE ARE SMART, BUT NOT WISE. INTELLIGENT, but not knowledgeable. IT IS AS IF HUMANITY has lost its souland society has lost its spirit. The prevailing rise of lawlessness andimmorality and violence and corruption, materialism and decadence has reducedour global VILLAGE TO ONE MASSIVE JUNGLE OF CIVIL CHAOS. And that's a paradox, isn't it? How can you be civilized and stillchaotic?

Humanity is like a battered ship drivenby the wind of change without anchors or rudder. And the question is, how did we get like this? Some say that this destructive cause began in the early '60s with the adventof the sexual revolution, better known as the free love era. However, perhaps it is more correct to call this period of social and culturalchange the lawless revolution, not the sexual revolution. It began as a general rebellion against authority.

Rebellion against established institutions and rebellion against law. The results was a release of a spirit of freedom without law and actions withoutresponsibility. Everything that was established wasquestioned, challenged, or shaken. Terms like truthand law and authority were considered suspect. CONCEPTS SUCH as relativism and humanism and freedom and scientific evidencebecame the benchmark of that day and still affects us today. The result was a generation that destroyed the concept of absolutes.

Nothing was sacred to them. The favorite cliche of the era that we callthe lawless revolution went like this. And I think all of youwho are over the age of 30 remember this place. It was all over the world. They said, "If it feels good, do it." You ever heard that before? That came from the '60s. AND WHAT DOES THAT MEAN? It means that it was no longer whether it was right or wrong, but ratherwhether it felt good. Man became his own regulator. He was nolonger regulated by conscience or by rightness or wrongness.

He was regulatedby how it felt. A generation laterwe are reaping the fruit of those seeds of lawlessness. There is a widespread disillusionment, FRUSTRATION, BITTERNESS, AND DEPRESSIONEVERYWHERE IN EVERY CULTURE, COMMUNITY, NATION, and country. OLD AND YOUNG, RICH AND POOR obscure and renowned, all suffer thesame experience. A life without purpose and fulfillment and direction. However, the present state of our world is not uniqueas in our slice of history. This is not something new.

A general review of human history over the past 5,000 yearswill reveal the previous descent of man into the cesspool of his own delusions. Nothing new. It seems AS IF EVERY GENERATION has a little spell ofinsanity. Where we ALL THINK WE DON'T need Godanymore and we DESCEND INTO THIS DARK ABYSS OF OUR OWN DESTRUCTION. But history will also reveal that in each CASEWHEN MAN FELL TO THE DARKEST PERIODS OF HIS DESCENTHE ALWAYS WAS LED by a magnetic search and a pursuit of spiritual, moral, andethical anchors.

In other words, when men become SODISILLUSIONED AND UPSET AT THEIR own losing and darkness and despair, THEYBEGIN TO SAY TO THEMSELVES, "We are no longer able to be gods ourselves." In essence, the descent of man also always resultsin a deep search for God. IT IS DURING THESE periods that manyreligions are created. IT IS THESE PERIODS WHEN MEN ARESEARCHING FOR GOD THAT OTHER RELIGIONS ARE EMBRACED OR EXPANDED. Matter of fact, these periods give way to the invention and the rise of newcults.

That's why the cults are blossoming everywhere and all kind ofnew groups COMING UP BECAUSE MAN IS IN SUCH A DECADENT ENVIRONMENT. HE'SDESTROYED EVERY ANCHOR THAT HE HAD THAT HE'S GRASPING FOR ANYTHING now to givehim some sense of control and absolutes. Violation of these lawsof God will always lead us to a search for God. Now, why? Because man was created to live by andexist within eternal laws. And he's built TO LIVE BY PRINCIPLESDESIGNED to preserve him, his eternal nature, and his physical habitation.

Violation of these laws is always predictable. YOU DON'T HAVE TO QUESTION WHAT'S GOING TO HAPPEN TO man when man disobey God. It's built in. You know it. READ HISTORY. THERE'S NOTHING new under thesun. WHEN WE WALK AWAY FROM GOD'S LAWS AND PRINCIPLES, OUR FUTURE'S ALREADYPREDICTED, DESTRUCTION. You see, God, OUR WONDERFUL CREATOR, DESIGNED us tocarry these laws in our hearts and in our minds so as to regulate anddiscipline our lives, our behavior, and our relationships. That's what Godintended.

These laws are principles and are whatwe are as AS HIS CREATED SUBJECTS have come to know as truths. Simply put, the greatest pursuit inherent in theheart of every man is the deep search for these truths to live by. Everybodyis searching for them. The atheist is looking for God. That's why HE'S ANATHEIST. WITHOUT THESE ESTABLISHED, SETTLED, AND TIMELESS TRUTHS, mankind is nothing morethan a hapless celestial experiment.

At the fall of man, as recorded in the book of Genesis chapter 3, man lost access and understanding to these truths and became a victim of hisown intellect. Thus, was the birth of humanism. Simply, man himself became the source and inventor of truth, which naturally madeit relative and consequently our chaotic dilemma. When you become the measure for your own conscience, then you are as good as yourconscience. However, God, in his mercy and grace, did not leave us to our self-destruction. Thank God. Can I hearamen?

BUT THROUGHOUT HISTORY, GOD HASINTERVENED TO REVEAL TO US THESE LIFE-GIVING, LIFE-PRESERVING, ANDETERNITY-PREPARING TRUTHS TO PROTECT and preserve mankind. They have come throughmany different generations. These truths have come through different cultures andindividuals AND CIRCUMSTANCES, BUT ARE ALWAYS WITH THE same integrity. The record of these timeless truths and principles are recorded in the mostimportant document that has ever given to man. It's in this book called theBible.

These laws and truths and principles arethe only security mankind has. These universal TIMELESS TRUTHS ARE THEANCHORS OF our lives and are necessary for a fruitful life in this barrenplanet. What do you call the truthsthat are in this book? Write it down. These are calleddoctrines. Everybody say doctrines. Now, a lot of people have said a lot of negative things about thethe study of doctrines.

But whatever has been said in recentyears derogatory to this branch of study has been ill-timedin view of the world's great need of sound, sober, satisfying truth. I don't think there's ever a time in history, in our generation, that we needsomething stable than we do right now. I mean, OUR YOUNG PEOPLE HAVE NO LAW. THE MARRIAGES HAVE NO PRINCIPLES. THE HOMES DOESN'T HAVE ANY FOUNDATION. EVERYTHING IS SHAKEN. IT SEEMS AS IF WE ARE OUT OF CONTROL.

THE TRUTH ABOUT GOD AND THE destiny of man and the way to eternal life cannever be unimportant to an an immortalcreature like you. We cannot discard, dismiss, and ignore God. The questions of the human heartare all the same. Who am I? Where am I from? Why was I born? Where am I going? WHAT AM I SUPPOSED TO DO WITH MY LIFE? THESE QUESTIONS ARE QUESTIONS OFDESTINY. THEY ARE IMMORTAL QUESTIONS.

And these are age-old, race-longquestions THAT WE MUST PERSONALLY ANSWER AND CAN ONLY BE forgot forgotten orignored when the race of man has sunk into idiocy and lost of the image ofGod. The scriptures teach usquote, "As a man thinketh, so is he." That means you and I are as good as what's in our minds. NOT ONLY THAT, THAT TERM ACTUALLY SAYS, "AS a manthinketh in his heart, that's the way the man will live." Theword heart there is an interesting word in the Hebrew language. It meansSUBCONSCIOUS MIND.

IT MEANS THE PART OF you that you live OUT OF. YOUR SUBCONSCIOUS MIND IS WHAT YOU DO WHEN YOU'RE UNDER PRESSURE. YOUR SUBCONSCIOUS MIND IS WHAT YOU SAY WHEN YOU ARE AFRAID. YOUR SUBCONSCIOUS MIND IS HOW YOU ACT WHEN YOU ARE SHOCKED. THAT'S THE real you. AND JESUS SAID, "OUT OF THE HEART, THESUBCONSCIOUS MIND, COMES ALL OF THE KILLING AND ALL THE VIOLENCE AND ALL THECRIME AND ALL THE BROKENNESS AND ALL THE DESPAIR." HE SAYS, "IN YOUR HEART ISWHERE THAT IS." THEREFORE, it is importantwhat's in your mind.

IT IS CRITICAL AND CRUCIALHOW YOU THINK. BECAUSE HOWEVER YOU THINK IS how youlive. Let me read it again. "As a man thinketh in his heart, SO WILL THE MANBE." WHICH MEANS WHATEVER YOU THINK ABOUTLIFE, WHATEVER YOU THINK ABOUT HUMANITY, WHATEVER YOU THINK ABOUT GOD IS HOWYOU'RE GOING TO LIVE. IS IT an amazingrevelation to you that we have children killing children and having NO REMORSE? WHY? BECAUSE THE VALUE OF HUMAN LIFE HAS BEEN REDUCED TO NOTHING BUT SOMEONEWHO'S IN MY WAY.

THAT MEANS THE THINKING OF HUMANITY HASBEEN SO SUBMERGED THAT WE no longer consider babies humans. To abort a child as an inconvenience has been accepted by our society as normal. Which means that human LIFE IS NO PROBLEM. NOW, YOU THINK ABOUT IT. IF A9-YEAR-OLD FINDS OUT THAT HIS MOTHER KILLED HIS BROTHER BEFORE HE CAME OUT, THEN THAT 9-YEAR-OLD HAVE NO PROBLEM TAKING A GUN AND SHOOTING HIS FRIEND. WHY? HUMAN LIFE HAS NO VALUE. YOU SEE, YOUR THINKING CONTROLS YOUR LIFE.

AND IFYOU THINK WRONG, YOU'RE GOING TO LIVE WRONG. Are you all here? That is why THE WORD OF GOD IS ALWAYSTRUE. AS A MAN THINKETH, SO is he. All of man's life turns on what hethinks, and most of all on what he thinks about God. If you think God is dead, you are a dangerous person. If you think THERE IS NO GOD, YOU ARE A VERY DANGEROUS TO SOCIETY. IF YOU THINK THAT THERE'S NO NO REPERCUSSIONS FOR YOUR FOR YOURBEHAVIOR, then you are a very dangerous person.

IN OTHER WORDS, WHERE THERE'S NO FEAR OF GOD, THERE'S GOING TO BE VIOLENCE ANDCRIME AND DESTRUCTION. NO WONDER WHY THE BIBLE SAYS THE FEAR OFMAN is the beginning of what? WISDOM. A MAN LIVES WISE WHEN HE BEGINS TO FEARGOD. I MEAN, THE PEOPLE IN THESE GANGS ANDPEOPLE WHO ARE BEATING UP PEOPLE AND SHOOTING PEOPLE, THEY HAVE NO FEAR OFGOD. ANY MAN WHO HAS NO FEAR of God will killyou without conscience. What is missing? WE HAVE THE WRONG STUFF IN the minds of our generation. And what's amazing is it's creeping into the church. AND GOD IS SAYING, "GET BACK TO DOCTRINE." I TELL YOU, FRIENDS, OUR WILL NOT BE SAVED UNLESS WE PUTourselves back on the rock.
